activity.notes: Marx settled permanently in London in 1849, undertook the research that became his critique of political economy there, and published the first volume of Capital in 1867. ATLAS records 1849-1867 as a representative London intellectual phase rather than equating residence through 1883 with continuous production at the same intensity.
